name: 1838 Mormon War
short_desc: Violence between Mormons, local opponents and state forces ends with the expulsion of Mormons from Missouri.
date_note: 6 August to 1 November 1838. Both endpoints fall in the same calendar year; the conflict lasted several months, not zero time.
